mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 73 degrees with clear skies at Harriet Park, though the air quality is moderate at 54. The moon is in a waning crescent phase tonight. Expect an overnight low of 70 degrees, and keep your umbrella handy because rain is predicted.

The City Clerk's office is finalizing the student-designed I Voted stickers for the November election. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing new development projects including a site plan for 201 South Main Street.

There is plenty to do in town tomorrow, starting with trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee. You can also head out for yoga at Insight Wellness, the downtown farmer's market, or pizza and a pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On August 8th, Verona police provided drone support to the Dane County Sheriff's Office to locate a burglary suspect who fled into a corn field after crashing their vehicle.

Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach. Since the store is currently closed, you can look forward to stopping by when they open tomorrow at 10 AM, when the flavor will switch to Chocolate Heath Crunch.
